groups.saying_opens: يهل أهل المدينة من ذي الحليفة

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: the first is the Prophet's words on the Medinan, Syrian and Najdi miqat (Ibn Umar last); «قال عبد الله وبلغني أن رسول الله ...» is a second saying whose gap «بلغني» is unnamed. The second saying's head is not written in the text. «- رضى الله عنهما -» is a blessing.
